name: skill-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for engineering work: a development-workflow pipeline from brainstorm to shipped change, domain modelling and Blueprint diagrams alongside code intelligence in the code plugin, codebase priming, rich diff and PR explainers, wiki generation, security sweeps and generated end-to-end suites, a game-development review board backed by cited rules and a generative game-design studio, multi-agent fleet orchestration, skill and MCP-server authoring, and a toolkit of thinking, discipline and verification skills.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Design, understand, and verify systems. Start with ddd for domain modelling, core for an existing codebase, keys for AGENTS.md instructions, blueprint for a standalone diagram, or explain-diff for a change. core primes a repo once — a deterministic zero-token knowledge graph via graphify plus a CORE tree of CLAUDE.md contracts with AGENTS.md symlinks — so later questions cost a graph query instead of a file sweep. keys installs KEYS, a self-maintaining AGENTS.md hierarchy, in the current project and folds CLAUDE.md and other agent-instruction files into it, so one AGENTS.md per boundary holds the rules. explain-diff turns a diff, branch or PR into a self-contained HTML explainer with background, intuition, a code walkthrough, a quiz, and embedded Blueprint diagrams from the same plugin; it narrates itself, reading its prose aloud with a follow-along player, when a local text-to-speech service is available. deepwiki generates and maintains wiki-style docs with line-level citations and validated Mermaid diagrams. e2e-harness discovers a polyglot system from its own docs and generates runnable end-to-end suites across Node, Python, Go, C#, Rust, Kafka and Playwright. security-sweep orchestrates a multi-agent OWASP, STRIDE, secrets, supply-chain and LLM-security audit with a verifier fan-out and a CSO report. complexity-sweep measures 14 complexity metrics on TypeScript and JavaScript and turns each violation into a refactoring. explain-diff is adapted from Geoffrey Litt's explain-diff gist. ddd kicks off the nine-step DDD Starter Modelling Process over one workspace with validators, a review page, diagrams and recorded decisions. Blueprint renders architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams with animated walkthroughs and offline fonts. The DDD and Blueprint tools require Node.js 18 or newer.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: A development workflow as a chained skill pipeline over one ai_docs/ workspace: prime the codebase, brainstorm a design, analyze it from eight perspectives, break it into SLC phases, write a zero-context implementation plan, execute it in batches with reviewer subagents or a swarm, verify against the plan, review from eleven perspectives, describe the change, and hand off. Bundles four agents (codebase-locator, codebase-analyzer, codebase-pattern-finder, code-reviewer). Adapted in part from obra/superpowers, HumanLayer, wshobson/agents and BMAD-METHOD; see NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: game
plugins.description: A review board for game work, backed by cited rules distilled from 38 game-development books. game-studio-cpo is the generalist entry point; the five auditors cover systems, balance and economy, code architecture, performance, and QA and ship-readiness.

plugins.name: game-design
plugins.description: Generative game design that runs headless: pick the target kinds of fun with MDA, ideate concepts under a constraint card with a boundaries-first gate, draw the core loops as flowcharts, write a reader-facing brief, and render a one-page design, design diagrams and an art-direction style sheet. Designs go to game:game-studio-cpo for critique.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Run a herdr multi-agent worker fleet. herdr-orchestrator decomposes the work, spawns and assigns workers by tier, answers blocked workers and integrates results through the horch CLI. herdr-worker is the other side of that protocol. herdr-atomic wraps the herdr terminal workspace manager in deterministic scripts. herdr-setup checks the machine (herdr CLI, horch on PATH, agent integrations) and fills only the gaps. Requires the herdr CLI (herdr.dev), which is not bundled.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: Cross-cutting skills: divergent ideation, human-sounding prose, spaced-repetition decks, model and subagent routing, an engineering persona, plan verification before and after implementation, and completion discipline for long autonomous runs. Plus eight vendored engineering disciplines: systematic debugging, test-driven development, receiving code review, git worktrees, advanced git workflows, error-handling patterns, code review excellence and API design principles. Contains third-party skills under their own licenses — see README.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Make more skills and tools. skill-creator builds, evaluates and benchmarks Claude Code skills; mcp-builder guides a well-designed MCP server in Python or TypeScript; harvest clones a GitHub repository you name and installs the skills it finds into your local skills directory. skill-creator and mcp-builder are owned copies of the Apache-2.0 skills from anthropics/skills — see README.
